instructions: Calm, warm science-documentary narrator. Unhurried, with a sense of wonder, clear articulation, a brief pause between sentences.

lines.text: This is a strange attractor of a language model's feedback loop: nearly three hundred thousand states of the model, from five hundred trajectories, drawn in the coordinates of its own internal state. Each color is the word the loop writes next.
The states lie on thin, folded sheets instead of filling the space. Measured from its Lyapunov exponents, the attractor's dimension is about one and a quarter.
At every step, nearby states move apart by about a third, and the attractor folds them back onto itself. That stretching and folding is what makes the text unpredictable.
And all of it is one small model, with half a billion parameters, writing words like is, there and existence, over and over, never quite the same way twice.
